prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080. Composition must be SQUARE, never wide or landscape.

CRITICAL - READ FIRST: the drawing must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES with NO frame, NO border line, NO box and NO white margin band; the stomach-wall shapes and the channel are CUT OFF by the image edge itself.

SCENE: A cheerful cartoon PARIETAL CELL (stomach acid cell) character works the acid pump in the wall of a stomach gland.
- The PARIETAL CELL is a big, plump, cushiony pear-shaped character, round and chubby, standing large on a gentle diagonal and filling most of the picture. It has a BIG FRIENDLY FACE: two large round eyes with small solid pupils, cheerful curved eyebrows, rosy round cheeks and a wide happy open grin. Two short stubby arms with simple mitten hands and two little stubby feet. It wears a simple worker's cap with a soft brim.
- With both mitten hands it works the long handle of a CHUNKY OLD-FASHIONED VILLAGE WATER PUMP with a fat spout, drawn big and simple. From the spout, THREE BIG FAT TEARDROPS tumble down into a WIDE OPEN CHANNEL - the gland's drain - that curves from the middle of the picture down and off the BOTTOM edge, drawn as two long simple curved bank lines with a few gentle wavy flow lines between them. The drops are large plain teardrop shapes, completely open for colouring.
- On the character's round tummy is one BIG ROUND PORTHOLE WINDOW (a plain circle) through which THREE CHUNKY BEAN SHAPES are visible side by side - its battery packs (mitochondria) - each bean a simple fat outline with one curved line inside.
- On the LEFT and RIGHT, the plump rounded bumps of two NEIGHBOUR GLAND-CELL characters press into the picture, each cut off by the left or right edge, each with its own simple happy face. Their rounded shoulders run off the left and right edges of the picture.
- Behind everything, two or three tall smooth arcs suggest the curving stomach-gland wall, running from the top area down and off the bottom corners; the arcs are cut off by the edges.
- Everything is drawn LARGE, SIMPLE and CHUNKY, with generous open white areas inside every shape so a child can colour them in.

STYLE - coloring book line art:
- BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed.
- ABSOLUTELY NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO stippling, NO cross-hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black areas anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only).
- Simple, cheerful, chunky cartoon shapes with plenty of white space.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN - the page is rejected if any of these appear:
- ANY decorative STARBURST, comic-style radiating burst, "pow"/impact star, sparkle burst, twinkle burst, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, motion rays or halo of rays behind, around or under any character. NO radiating lines of any kind anywhere.
- ANY rectangle, rounded rectangle, square box outline, picture frame, panel edge, comic panel, border line, outer margin line, ground-line box, or vignette. The drawing must NOT sit inside a box of any kind. Do NOT draw a thin black line anywhere near the edge of the image. There must be NO white margin between the artwork and the image edge.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks anywhere.
- NO speech bubble, thought bubble or balloon of any kind (one is added separately afterwards).
- NO fire, NO smoke, NO steam clouds, NO sizzling effects, NO blood, no wounds, no scary or angry faces, nothing gruesome.
- NO human figure and no hands other than the characters' own mitten hands.
- NO long wavy hairs, NO fur carpet and NO beating cilia anywhere.
